project_type: Greenfield Python 3.11-targeted PySpark data pipeline (AWS EMR Serverless) + Terraform IaC + Step Functions orchestration + Athena. POC/demo scale, easy complexity. Authored and verified entirely on a local Windows host with NO AWS access.
language: Python (target language level 3.11 for the EMR runtime; local interpreter is 3.14) and Terraform HCL (AWS provider ~> 5.x).
build_system: No compiled build. Python is byte-compiled with `python -m compileall`. Terraform is authored only (NOT applied). pyproject.toml declares metadata and pins black/ruff target-version = py311; requirements.txt lists PyYAML + boto3 (installed) and pyspark 3.5.* (NOT installed locally, smoke-only). QUIRK: on this host `python` is Python 3.14.7 but code MUST stay 3.11-compatible (no syntax/stdlib newer than 3.11); a green py_compile on 3.14 is a smoke check, not a 3.11 guarantee. QUIRK: terraform, java, and pyspark are ALL absent from PATH.
test_framework: pytest 9.1.1 (installed). Pure-Python unit tests under tests/ only; no Spark, no AWS. The design's §13 local-checks orchestrator (scripts/run_local_checks.py) wraps compileall + import-safe check + generator run + pytest + skip-if-absent terraform/Spark steps.
test_command: pytest  (and the full local gate: python scripts/run_local_checks.py)
verification_instructions: MANDATORY (must pass): (1) `python -m compileall src data scripts` plus py_compile on each job entry point; (2) import-safe check of every src/common module (no Spark session built); (3) run the generator for real `python -m data.generator.generate --out ./_local_out` and assert each table's row count is inside its configured generator.row_counts [min,max] range and PII columns are present/populated; (4) `pytest tests/` green (lineage JSON shape, masking determinism incl. tokenize_id against a precomputed literal, quality enforce_gate raise/no-raise + QualityResult.passed, config_loader required-key validation, io_paths exact path strings incl. the <table> segment, audit JSON shape with table_name + Optional->None fields). SKIP (print SKIPPED, do NOT fail): terraform validate/fmt (terraform absent); local Spark+Iceberg smoke (java+pyspark absent). DEFER TO AWS (cannot verify here): Spark transform runtime behavior, Athena<->Iceberg round-trip, EMR->CloudWatch log delivery, Step Functions execution, Iceberg overwrite/MERGE semantics. The canonical local gate is `python scripts/run_local_checks.py` exiting 0 with steps 5-6 SKIPPED.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The generator writes 4 landing files to ./_local_out (customers.csv, accounts.csv, cards.csv, transactions.json) via `python -m data.generator.generate --out ./_local_out`. These are NOT checked in (./_local_out, *.parquet, warehouse/ are gitignored). No other generated-but-committed artifacts. Clean up ./_local_out and __pycache__ before finishing.
environment_constraints: NO AWS access from this host: do NOT run terraform apply, EMR jobs, or Athena queries. terraform, java, pyspark are NOT installed; any check needing them must skip-if-absent, never fail. Windows/PowerShell shell. Python 3.14.7 is the local interpreter but the authoring ceiling is 3.11. No git repo exists yet (no commits). Do NOT push.
contribution_requirements: Keep everything POC-scale, easy-complexity, clean, HEAVILY COMMENTED, demo-friendly: clarity over production hardening. This is the BASELINE to iterate on later; do NOT add future scope (OpenLineage/Marquez, external Great Expectations, Lake Formation masking, cost dashboards, CI/CD, DR). Technology stack is LOCKED: EMR Serverless + PySpark, Terraform, Step Functions, custom JSON lineage. Spark/boto3/pyyaml imports MUST be lazy (inside functions) so modules byte-compile and import on the bare host; only spark_session.py may hold Spark config, still imported lazily inside build_spark. Author valid HCL only (no apply).
key_patterns: Deterministic naming from project=ocbc-poc + env=dev -> name_prefix ocbc-poc-dev (design §2). ONE data-lake bucket with per-layer prefixes + ONE athena-results bucket; bucket names carry the account id. Glue DB names use underscores (ocbc_poc_dev_<layer>). PER-TABLE keying for lineage/quality/audit JSON: lineage/<run_id>/<job>/<table>.json etc. (Finding 1) — io_paths.{lineage,quality,audit_json}_path all take a `table` arg. Audit grain is ONE ROW PER TABLE PER JOB (Finding 3); status enum is EXACTLY {SUCCESS, DQ_FAILED, FAILED}; audit column is `table_name` (never `table`, a reserved word). DQ call sequence is a hard contract (§6.2a): run_expectations -> emit_quality (ALWAYS before gate) -> enforce_gate; enforce_gate does NO I/O and only raises; on QualityGateError the caller writes a DQ_FAILED audit row BEFORE re-raising. expect_referential stores the parent TABLE NAME string (never a DataFrame); caller passes ref_dfs={name: silver_parent_df}; missing key -> hard dq_fail. Silver processing order fixed: customers->accounts->cards->transactions (parents before children); referential source is the JUST-WRITTEN silver parent. Masking ONLY in silver->canonical; tokenize_id = first16(lowercasehex(sha256(utf8(salt+value)))) salt-prefix; salt precedence PIPELINE_MASK_SALT env > config.masking.salt > hard startup fail. Canonical masks IN PLACE (no _masked suffix; suffix only in gold marts); date_of_birth REPLACED by birth_year:int; national_id retained holding the 16-char token. customer_360 built from SEPARATE per-customer aggregations joined on customer_id (NOT a flat join). Money aggregates kept per currency (no FX). Four separate per-stage entry scripts; CLI = --run-id/--env/--all(default)/--table(excl, dev-only)/--local; NO --job (job name derived from filename). Step Functions passes --run-id/--env dev/--all and routes every stage's Catch[States.ALL] to ONE shared PipelineFailed Fail state (§8). Bronze reject contract (§6.1): non-empty source value casting to null -> _rejected/ Parquet row with _reject_reason (<col>:uncastable, semicolon-joined), input_rows = output_rows + rejected_rows. row_count>=1 is CRITICAL only for transactions, WARN for the other three. --inject-dq-failure plants two transactions rows with SAME transaction_id AND SAME _ingested_at but differing in one non-key column so full-row distinct() keeps both and dedupe cannot disambiguate -> uniqueness gate fires deterministically. country_allowed = [SG,US,MY,GB,IN,AU] from config. generator.row_counts ranges: customers [90,110], accounts [140,160], cards [110,130], transactions [700,900].
